Estimate Relative Humidity from Air Temperature and Dew Point Temperature

Source: R/dew_point.R
relative_humidity.Rd

Computes relative humidity (%) from air temperature and dew point temperature using the Magnus-Tetens approximation. This is the inverse of dew_point().

Usage

relative_humidity(temperature, dewpoint)

Arguments

temperature

Numeric. Air temperature (°C).

dewpoint

Numeric. Dew point temperature (°C). Should not exceed temperature.

Value

Numeric. Relative humidity (%), between 0 and 100 when dewpoint <= temperature.

Details

Relative humidity is the ratio of the saturation vapour pressure at the dew point to that at the air temperature:

$$ RH = 100 \cdot \exp\left(\frac{a \cdot T_{dew}}{b + T_{dew}} - \frac{a \cdot T}{b + T}\right) $$

with \(a = 17.62\) and \(b = 243.12\) (Alduchov and Eskridge, 1996).

References

Alduchov, O. A., & Eskridge, R. E. (1996). Improved Magnus Form Approximation of Saturation Vapor Pressure. Journal of Applied Meteorology, 35(4), 601–609. doi:10.1175/1520-0450(1996)035<0601:IMFAOS>2.0.CO;2

Examples

# Relative humidity for 10 °C air temperature and 6.7 °C dew point
relative_humidity(10, 6.7)
#> [1] 79.96699

# Vectorized input
relative_humidity(c(5, 10, 15), c(3.5, 4.8, 4.7))
#> [1] 90.03161 70.11943 50.16902
